subject: S20 rework landed (ee7bd45): separate-origin player Space deployed and tested with real YouTube; review20 fixed; CI queued
body:
S20 rework landed: ee7bd45 on claude/naadi-shared (migration 0030, single head). CI: https://github.com/arrowassassin/naadi/actions/runs/44036450059 (queued when I looked: I have NOT seen it green; I will watch it and fix anything of mine that is red).

Per lead decision 20261117T064151-lead-5822fd (separate-origin player Space) and review20 20261117T063040:

BLOCKER (real player never readies): fixed by design change.
- deploy/player-space/{README.md,index.html,player.js}: static page with its own CSP (meta: script-src 'self' youtube.com s.ytimg.com; frame-src youtube-nocookie; connect-src 'none'). It accepts `init` only from the Naadi origin in ?parent= that is on its allow-list (the Naadi Space + loopback) AND is the page that really embeds it (ancestorOrigins, else referrer); every message needs source + EXACT origin + shape.
- Deployed with HF_TOKEN from env (scripts/deploy_player_space.sh --verify): https://arrowassassin-naadi-player.static.hf.space/ (served player.js sha matches the repo, CSP present). Workflow .github/workflows/deploy-player.yml uploads on changes to deploy/player-space on main.
- Naadi side: iframe src = player origin + /index.html?parent=<app origin>, sandbox="allow-scripts allow-same-origin" (+ allow= autoplay/fullscreen/pip/encrypted-media); bridge checks event.origin === player origin and posts to that exact origin (never "*"). Player origin = ONE value: Settings.youtube_player_origin (env YOUTUBE_PLAYER_ORIGIN) feeds the CSP frame-src, the Permissions-Policy and /api/public-config video_player_origin (web reads it via playerConfig.ts). Parent CSP: script-src 'self', frame-src 'self' + that origin only.
- Deviation, with evidence: no `allow-presentation` in the sandbox attribute. Chromium and WebKit log "'allow-presentation' is an invalid sandbox flag" (a console error that fails our zero-console-errors e2e). Fullscreen comes from the frame's allow="fullscreen" + the Permissions-Policy (fullscreen=(self "<player origin>")), and I measured it: document.fullscreenEnabled === true inside the real nested embed.
- REAL PLAYBACK TESTED: e2e/video-live.spec.ts (E2E_LIVE_YOUTUBE=1, @live, opt-in) against the deployed Space and real YouTube through the sandbox proxy, chromium-laptop-1440: player readies, plays (position advances), speed 1.5x over the bridge, chapter seek moves the playhead, fullscreen enabled. Passed twice. WebKit live not run here (proxy/WebKit); device checklist updated (iOS may need a second tap on YouTube's own play button).
- Matrix e2e (video.spec) serves the REAL deploy/player-space files at the player origin through Playwright routes with a fake YT API: CI contacts neither YouTube nor the Space. Unit tests: origin config, exact-origin acceptance/rejection (wrong origin, "null", suffix attack, own origin), targets never "*", plus apps/web/src/video/playerPage.test.ts which loads player.js itself in jsdom: allow-list, ancestor/referrer check, and message validation compared case by case with bridge.ts so the two cannot drift. Python tests: parent CSP has no third-party script/frame, frame-src == 'self' + player origin, fullscreen delegation, origin validation.

HIGH 2 (SQLite hang): collection opened read-only with query_only, trusted_schema off, authorizer WITHOUT SQLITE_RECURSIVE, a progress-handler wall-clock deadline (20 s), and any view or trigger (or missing notes/cards table) refuses the package with anki_corrupt. Tests: your recursive-CTE view is refused in < 3 s; triggers/views refused; deadline test.
HIGH 3 (cloze regex): replaced by a linear tokenizer with an explicit stack (depth cap 32, unclosed openers literal); field cap 200k chars and template cap 20k are skipped before rendering. Timing test: 50,000 repetitions of five hostile shapes < 3 s. Real Anki-written packages (current + legacy) still parse.
MEDIUM 4 (speed label): the pressed button no longer carries text-text; e2e asserts contrast > 4.5 on the selected label.
MEDIUM 5 (fullscreen): see above (Permissions-Policy delegated to the player origin; verified in the real embed).
LOW 6: flashcards.source_id (seed -> naadi-original-v1, anki_import -> user-upload with a check; importer sets it). LOW 7: own-card insert/update policies now require anki_guid, anki_note_type and source_id to be null (db test: typed card cannot carry them; import without the source is refused).
NIT 8: every attempt spends quota (no hidden retries; 5xx retried by us, each counted); unit test.
Migration 0030 verified on a DB that went 0025 -> 0030 (applied the other segments' 0026-0029 too).

TESTS (local, own stack, never the hosted DB): unit 1562 passed; lint/typecheck green; db tests for my areas + rls/rls_coverage/schema_doc/live_check: 265 passed; e2e video + anki + csp specs on webkit-ipad-portrait, webkit-ipad-landscape, webkit-phone-390, chromium-laptop-1440, --retries=0: 72/72, twice in a row. NOT mine and failing locally: tests/db/test_migrations downgrade (0024's agent_health `check (kind in ())`, S19), embeddings tests (model cache), the flaky packages/ink timing test.
Screenshots: .tmp/shots/{video,video-live,anki} (not committed).

OPEN: S15 `anki_deck` placement (registry now landed; wiring not done yet), WebKit/iOS real-YouTube check on a device.
